quick_brief: Challenge of the fourth week: Test your mathematical and physics skills in programming the collision and bounce of balls (Ball Component) and displaying and managing tasks in the ListView!

questions.text: Which moving ballistic object placed inside the Canvas has a spherical shape and physical properties ready to bounce?
Which throwing event is automatically executed once the moving ball touches the edge or border of the Canvas?

Which interface element do we use to display the List on the application screen in an interactive vertical manner?
Which property of the ListView element should the list be assigned to display its contents immediately on the screen to the user?
When a collision occurs between Ball1 and the player's racket, to change the direction of the ball to bounce realistically, we adjust the angle of movement called:

options: Using the local other variable provided by the event
Using the value of X and Y
